content.transcript: If you're taking laxatives on your GLP-1, you might actually be fighting against your own medication. Here's why nothing's working. Here's what's actually happening. GLP-1 medications work by slowing your entire digestive system. That's how they help you lose weight. Food moves through slower. You feel full longer. But that same slowing causes everything else. Your stomach takes longer to empty. Your intestines barely move. Food just sits there and ferments. That's where the sulfur burps come from. And waste backs up because there's nothing pushing it through. Now here's why regular laxatives don't work. Stimulant laxatives trigger muscle contractions. But your GLP-1 is actively suppressing those contractions. You're fighting against your own medication. Fiber adds bulk. But bulk needs movement to work. You don't have movement. It's the wrong mechanism entirely. No wonder nothing was working. What you actually need is something that works with your slowed system, not against it. GLP-1 SOS uses magnesium citrate. It draws water into your intestines gently. No contractions needed. Just soft, comfortable relief. And ginger root. Studies show ginger actually speeds up stomach emptying. The exact opposite of what your GLP-1 is doing. That's why the sulfur burps stop. Food empties before it can ferment. Within three days, I went gently. No cramping. No urgency. No emergency. Day two, the sulfur burps stopped. My energy came back. Within a week, now I wake up, have my coffee, and go. Like clockwork. I'm back to brunch with my girlfriends. Just two capsules with dinner. They have a 60-day money-back guarantee. So you've got nothing to lose. I love that the capsules are clear. You can actually see the herbs inside. No mystery ingredients. Stop fighting your medication. Work with it. I just wish I'd found this sooner.
